column3: What this means for Kestrel and Co.
Know what sells, what is abandoned, what revenue is lost at payment, and which products carry the discount.
Know how people find a product, what they search for, whether they sign in, and where they give up.
Know whether the navigation, the banners, the filters and the imagery are doing the job they were built for.
Know which campaigns and which channels bring visits, and which of them bring orders.
Know when the site is throwing errors, when pages are slow, and when collection itself has stopped working.

orange: Kestrel and Co. responsive website (www.kestrelandco.example), desktop and mobile browser.
One production report suite and one development report suite.
Implementation through the existing tag management property.
iOS and Android applications. Listed separately on the Out of Scope sheet with reasons.
Point of sale and call centre orders. Listed separately on the Out of Scope sheet with reasons.
Everything needed to answer how the business is performing. Signed off before build starts.
Behavioural depth: filtering, sorting, reviews, wishlist, imagery. Scoped after Phase 1 is live.
